observations.title: Google #BuildHybridAI 2026 now lists a November 11 start and $30,000 grand prize
observations.claim: The current official Devpost page lists the event for November 11–30, 2026, says submissions open November 11 and close November 30 at 2:00 PM Pacific, and advertises $30,000 in cash prizes with one $30,000 grand-prize winner. Solo or team entry is permitted; participants must be above the legal age of majority in an allowed jurisdiction. The linked official rules page still says the full rules are not yet available. This differs from the November 1 journal observation of a November 9 start and $10,000 prize; the reason for the discrepancy (organizer amendment versus earlier capture/recording error) is unresolved.
observations.why_now: Scheduled recheck of the promised November 9 rules release found a material discrepancy in the current official dates and advertised prize. The current event page and linked rules page were opened directly; complete rules remain unavailable.
observations.value: Advertised $30,000 one-winner cash prize, conditional on eligibility, final rules, judging and selection; not guaranteed founder income or generally available funding.
observations.eligibility: Current event page allows solo or team entry and lists entrants above the legal age of majority in allowed countries/territories, subject to standard exclusions. Full official rules are not yet available.
observations.friction: Requires a project demonstrating Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference and submission by November 30 at 2:00 PM Pacific. Full rules, detailed submission requirements and bonus challenges are still pending. A three-week build window and winner-take-all prize create substantial effort and uncertainty.
observations.observed_delta: Current official page now states November 11–30 and $30,000 cash prize, versus the prior journal's November 9–30 and $10,000. The historical observation is preserved; whether the organizer changed the event or the earlier capture was inaccurate remains unresolved.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not treat the prize headline as accessible funding or customer revenue. Full rules are pending. Do not divert SECONDS MATTER work without an owner decision.

observations.title: Cloudflare D1 documentation now lists the 50 MB query-result limit as effective
observations.claim: Cloudflare's D1 limits page, last updated October 30, 2026, lists a maximum query result size of 50 MB and its footnote states that the limit took effect November 4, 2026. REST API import and export operations are exempt. This confirms the current first-party documentation reflects the announced effective date; no live oversized query was executed to test runtime enforcement.
observations.why_now: Scheduled recheck after the November 4 effective date. The current first-party limits page confirms the published 50 MB limit and effective date. Production enforcement was not independently exercised.
observations.value: Avoids oversized-query failures through pagination or narrower result sets; no direct cash, credits or revenue. No active LEVERAGE//SEEKER D1 deployment is verified.
observations.eligibility: Cloudflare D1 users whose SQL query results exceed 50 MB. REST API import and export operations are exempt from this response-size limit.
observations.friction: Affected queries must reduce selected columns or paginate. No current project workload or affected query is established, and no live API behavior was tested.
observations.observed_delta: Scheduled post-effective-date review confirms the official limits page now lists 50 MB and explicitly says the limit took effect November 4. This is a documentation recheck, not a live production test.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not claim that a live query failure was observed or that the founder has an affected D1 workload.

observations.title: AMD AI Developer Program offers a choice of $100 AMD Cloud or $50 Fireworks credits
observations.claim: AMD says its AI Developer Program is free for approved developers. Members complete a member-perks form and select either $100 in AMD Developer Cloud credits or $50 in Fireworks AI credits; after verification, AMD sends a redemption link or promo code. AMD credits expire 30 days after successful account creation or login through the link. Fireworks promo codes must be redeemed within 90 days of issuance; redeemed credits remain available until consumed. Fireworks is a third-party platform subject to its own terms.
observations.why_now: First-party terms and the alternative Fireworks credit are absent from the current generated intelligence feed. A prior chat-only finding was not persisted, so this is the first durable journal record.
observations.value: Choose $100 AMD Developer Cloud credit OR $50 Fireworks AI credit. These are alternatives, not stackable cash or guaranteed income.
observations.eligibility: Free program membership for approved developers. The member-perks form and AMD verification are required; the member chooses one credit option. Fireworks account creation and redemption are also required.
observations.friction: Approval is not guaranteed. AMD credit has a 30-day consumption window after activation; Fireworks code must be redeemed within 90 days and then remains subject to Fireworks terms. No membership approval, credit issuance or redemption is verified.
observations.observed_delta: Adds the alternative $50 Fireworks option and distinct redemption/expiry terms to the durable feed; no evidence establishes when the option was introduced.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not count both options as available value. A short AMD expiry can destroy unused credit; only claim value when there is a real inference workload.

observations.title: Upwork buyer requests GHL lead follow-up and missed-call text-back for $20
observations.claim: An Upwork-indexed public listing posted November 9, 2026 requests GoHighLevel automation in an existing account: instant SMS to new leads, email/SMS follow-up, source tags, pipeline stages, lead assignment and notifications, missed-call text-back, and automatic stopping after a response or next step. It advertises a $20 fixed price. The indexed activity snapshot shows 20–50 proposals, one interview and a client view about six hours before the search snapshot; no hire is shown. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403, so details remain provisional.
observations.why_now: A distinct same-day public hiring request provides a specific budget and acceptance requirement. It is useful feature/price evidence, but the listing could not be opened directly and is not a confirmed contract.
observations.value: $20 advertised one-time fixed budget if selected and delivered; not a contract, earned revenue or settled payment.
observations.eligibility: Worldwide applicants; requires GoHighLevel workflow automation and SMS integration experience. The founder's portfolio, account access and delivery qualification are unverified.
observations.friction: Indexed snapshot shows 20–50 proposals and one interview against a $20 gross budget. Platform fees, account access, message/telecom charges and consent constraints remain. Direct page retrieval returned 403.
observations.observed_delta: New November 9 listing includes a specific stop-on-response requirement, reinforcing that follow-up automation must halt when a lead replies or advances.
observations.anti_leverage: Low one-time budget and generic workflow scope indicate commoditized setup work, not recurring service demand. No hire or payment is shown; do not use $20 as a recurring service price.
observations.source_access_note: Upwork's indexed result exposed the listing details and activity snapshot; direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403. Retain as provisional until independently rechecked.

observations.title: Home-services operator seeks a $1,500 GHL voice-AI and missed-call recovery snapshot
observations.claim: An Upwork-indexed public listing posted November 1 seeks a master GoHighLevel snapshot for independent pest-control companies, including an AI voice agent, missed-call text-back, lead response under 60 seconds, a 10-touch follow-up sequence, calendar booking, review requests and a recovered-revenue report. It advertises $1,500 fixed across three milestones: 30% kickoff November 5, 40% demo November 12 and 30% handoff November 20. The buyer requires two live home-services builds and Top Rated or Expert-Vetted status. The indexed snapshot shows 20–50 proposals, 16 interviews, five invites and last viewed the prior week; no hire or payment is shown. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403.
observations.why_now: A higher-value public implementation request surfaced during buyer-demand review. It shows an agency/operator seeking a reusable missed-call/voice workflow, but it is not an end contractor buying a subscription and its hiring outcome remains unverified.
observations.value: $1,500 advertised fixed project budget, conditional on selection and milestone acceptance; not a contract, earned revenue or settled payment.
observations.eligibility: Worldwide freelancers, but the buyer requires two live voice-AI or missed-call builds in home services, Top Rated or Expert-Vetted status, and GoHighLevel experience. Founder qualification is not established.
observations.friction: Indexed snapshot shows 20–50 proposals and 16 interviews. The November 5 kickoff milestone has passed; direct page retrieval returned 403. Requires a live demo, proof of prior builds, screen-share and telecom/compliance knowledge.
observations.observed_delta: New indexed hiring request advertises $1,500 for a reusable home-services missed-call/voice snapshot and includes a measurable recovered-revenue report; no hire or payment is visible.
observations.anti_leverage: This is agency-side subcontracting, not a contractor subscription sale. High portfolio requirements and a passed kickoff milestone limit immediate accessibility. Do not treat the advertised budget as paid revenue or evidence of recurring demand.
observations.source_access_note: Upwork's indexed result exposed the scope, budget and activity snapshot; direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403. Current live status and hiring outcome remain unverified.
